name: Pico
about: In the style of the Pico CSS framework, version 2.

settings.font-sans: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, Helvetica, Arial, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
settings.font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
settings.shadow-sm: 0.0145rem 0.029rem 0.174rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.05 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0.0625rem 0.125rem 0.75rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.08 * var(--t-shadow-strength)))
settings.shadow-md: 0.0145rem 0.029rem 0.174rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.05 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0.0625rem 0.125rem 0.75rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.08 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0.2085rem 0.417rem 2.502rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.11 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0.5rem 1rem 6rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.15 * var(--t-shadow-strength)))
settings.shadow-lg: 0.0145rem 0.029rem 0.174rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.08 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0.0625rem 0.125rem 0.75rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.12 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0.2085rem 0.417rem 2.502rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.16 * var(--t-shadow-strength))), 0.5rem 1rem 6rem rgb(0 0 0 / calc(0.22 * var(--t-shadow-strength)))
